lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart of mine, this wayward heart.

lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera, kyun bujh gaya, aawargi?
couplets.en: Why has this wayward heart of mine gone dark, O wandering?

lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart of mine, this wayward heart.

lines: Is dasht mein ek shehar tha, woh kya hua, aawargi?
couplets.en: There was a city in this wilderness once, O wandering, what became of it?

lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart of mine, this wayward heart.

lines: Kal shab mujhe be-shakl ki aawaaz ne chaunka diya
couplets.en: Last night a voice without a face startled me.

lines: Maine kaha tu kaun hai, usne kaha aawargi
couplets.en: I asked who it was, and it said wandering.

lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart of mine, this wayward heart.

lines: Logon, bhala us shehar mein kaise jiyenge hum?
couplets.en: Tell me, how are we to live in such a city?

lines: Jahaan ho jurm tanha sochna, lekin saza aawargi
couplets.en: There, to think alone is a crime, and the sentence is to wander.

lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart of mine, this wayward heart.

lines: Ek ajnabi jhonke ne jab poochha mere gham ka sabab
couplets.en: When a passing gust asked what lay behind my sorrow.

lines: Sehra ki bheegi ret par maine likha aawargi
couplets.en: On the desert's damp sand I wrote one word, wandering.

lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart of mine, this wayward heart.

lines: Kal raat tanha chaand ko dekha tha maine khwaab mein
couplets.en: Last night I saw the lonely moon in a dream.

lines: Kal raat tanha chaand ko dekha tha maine khwaab mein
couplets.en: Last night I saw the lonely moon in a dream.

lines: Mohsin, mujhe raas aayegi shayad sada aawargi
couplets.en: Perhaps a life of wandering will suit me after all, Mohsin.

lines: Yeh dil, yeh paagal dil mera
couplets.en: This heart of mine, this wayward heart.
